description: This file contains database migration and setup scripts for support-related doctypes in an ERPNext instance. It reloads document types, updates issue priorities, and migrates service level and agreement priorities to child tables, establishing or updating related documents accordingly.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reloading documents and setting priorities for issues, service levels, and agreements.

methods.name: set_issue_priority()
methods.description: Creates Issue Priority documents for each unique priority option if they do not already exist.

methods.name: set_priority_for_issue()
methods.description: Assigns priority values to existing issues, especially after changing the 'priority' field to a Link type.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level()
methods.description: Migrates 'priority' and related fields from Service Level doctype to a child table, ensuring multiple priorities are supported.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level_agreement()
methods.description: Migrates priorities from Service Level Agreements into a child table with support for multiple entries, including handle for customer entity type.
